title: fix(ui): keep subagent avatars on completion
body:
Related: #203243

## What Problem This Solves

In the chat transcript, a launched subagent has a colored avatar, but its completion line switches to a generic robot. The same agent loses its visual identity when it finishes.

## User Impact

Named subagents keep the same avatar and color when they finish, fail, time out, or are stopped. Clicking the name still opens the same session. Completion events remain separate from tool groups.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the existing session-keyed name/avatar component in completion rows, with and without session navigation. Remove the redundant leading robot entirely for named completions, without reserving an empty icon column. Anonymous completion summaries retain their existing generic icon and copy.

This is independent of #203243: no summary, spacing, grouping, CSS, or protocol changes.

## Evidence

Matched before/after captures use the actual production-built Control UI with synthetic Gateway history, on the same Studio host and viewport. Before: main at `4266d0f0bf3d`; after: `ae0e2773b8fc`. This checks rendering, not a live model run.

### Clean comparison

Before:

![Before: completion replaces the launch avatar with a generic robot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/89df9a2d-6a98-4697-aef4-fa7c21b35103)

After:

![After: completion retains the launch avatar and color](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3054b93d-d454-41ca-9928-7187c86aae91)

### Annotated comparison

Before:

![Before: generic completion icon highlighted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/802ca80c-3204-48e9-a5fa-29b8884045dc)

After:

![After: matching completion avatar highlighted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e4bea6b-0760-40db-a0e5-92fb5b113c12)

Light theme was also checked:

![Light theme: before](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/394eee8b-1eb4-4f22-aa8b-3315f162c61f)

![Light theme: after](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a4d399ba-dfe0-4794-8da4-0c1ddf4fea83)

- Production builds and focused screenshot checks passed in dark and light themes.
- Existing grouped-chat coverage: 22 tests passed (5.24 s Vitest; 6.08 s wrapper).
- Temporary component checks: 5 passed, covering completion statuses, session navigation, rename identity, static names, overflow, and anonymous fallback. These proof fixtures remain outside the PR.
- UI typecheck, targeted lint, formatting, `git diff --check`, and the full selected `check:changed` gate passed.
- Native Codex review and local autoreview (P0–P2, base `4266d0f0bf3d` to the final one-file diff) found no actionable issues. Local ClawSweeper was unavailable; ClawSweeper has acknowledged this PR and hosted review is pending.
- No permanent tests added for the icon-only presentation change. Existing coverage is preserved; CI timing is pending.
